steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.

In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and cloves. In a separate bowl, mix together milk, egg and oil until well blended. Stir milk mixture into flour mixture. Fold in apple. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour 20 minutes, until loaf springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool in pan 10 minutes before removing to wire rack to cool completely.

raw_recipe.headline: Apple Pie Bread
raw_recipe.description: A quick bread spiced with cinnamon and cloves and speckled with chunks of apple.
raw_recipe.name: Apple Pie Bread

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.

In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and cloves. In a separate bowl, mix together milk, egg and oil until well blended. Stir milk mixture into flour mixture. Fold in apple. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour 20 minutes, until loaf springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool in pan 10 minutes before removing to wire rack to cool completely.

review.reviewBody: Excellent bread, but I will definitely use about 1/2 the amount of cloves next time.

I like this but made a few changes on my second try and it turned out much fluffier. I used 1 cup whole grain flour with 2 cups white flour, added 2 TBSP ground flax, used 3 TBSP cinnamon but no cloves, cut the baking powder by 1/3 and added 2 TSP baking soda and 2 TSP apple cider vinegar. This is so good I could almost eat the whole thing myself!

This is super easy. I took some of the others advice and used less cloves but added nutmeg and vanilla. I also used a larger loaf pan. I made 2 because my family really loves it. I also added cranberries and walnuts to the second.

very easy and good. I added a 1/2 cup of sour cream and a splash of vanilla. Also added a topping with 1/4 cup of chopped nuts, 1/4 cup chopped apples and a TBLS of butter and a teaspoon of cinnamon. Put in 2 bread pans.

My husband RAVED about this. I omitted the cloves, just personal preference. Other change was 1c of oats for 1c of flour. UPDATE: The second time I made it, I also added about 1c of chopped walnuts, and a big handful (1/2c maybe?) of raisins. This was delicious both times.

I had the opposite problem to most people - too dry! Possibly because I divided it into four mini loaf pans. It just did not taste 'apple' enough for me, and the batter seemed to lack SOMETHING. But it was good enough to inspire me to make it a second time, with some tinkering. My best inspiration was to add cream cheese to it. I added half a cup and it really made it have a better texture and flavor. I also increased the apples to two cups - have since read that someone else doubled the apples, which would be 3 cups - I can see that because even just adding 1/2 cup more didn't make a huge difference. I like clove, so I left it as it was, but just about doubled the cinnamon. I really like the spices to "kick" - I double all the spices when I make pumpkin pie!

Anyway, the 'second generation' of this recipe was much better and I will make it again with the cream cheese - and will add even more apples next time around.

I took two mini loaves to my small office this a.m. and by 9:30 they were gone!

Turned out nicely, overall. As recommended by other reviewers, I skipped the cloves (didn't have them, in any case), but added nutmeg. I also doubled the amount of apples, and substituted 1 c. oats for 1 c.flour. Baked it in a bundt pan (made a big bundt) for 1hr to make sure it was done all the way through - though the top was still a bit darker than I like. Really did make the house smell great! Would make again, perhaps as muffins (do not have muffin tins right now - as a grad student, it's a wonder I've got anything around!!).

Awesome!!! I substituted whole wheat flour for half of the flour and applesauce for the oil. I also added 2 tablespoons of fat free sour cream. I used 2 tsp of cinnamon and 1/2 tsp of nutmeg in place of the cloves. The bread turned out moist & delicious and it was healthy :)

This bread was ok, but I've had better. I did end up putting a streusel topping on some because I thought it needed something more. After reading the reviews, I did cut back on baking powder and cloves. I added extra cinnamon and extra Apple.

Yummy, i changed this into 24 muffins and put in almost double the amount of apples. I dunno how long i cooked them in my convection oven, but it was quite a while. I added more cinnamon and less cloves. Everyone liked them, tasted good with raspberry preserves. I added a bit less baking powder, only 3 tsp, but it still seemed to have an odd taste. I will make again.The inside was like apple pie when they were warm out the oven, nice and gooey from the fresh apples.

I made this recipe to use up red delicious apples. It made 4 mini loaves (1 1/3 c size pans) and one half size mini loaf. I cooked for 40 minutes and let cool in pan 15 minutes. I also used 1 cup whole wheat flour in place of 1 c white flour. They turned out really moist and tasty and they're low fat too.
My kitchen smelled so fabulous while this was in the oven. Yummmm
I followed the recipe exactly and will definitely make it again!
Didn't like the flavor
easy to make but Wayyyyy to much baking powder! Had to throw it away
Add pecans - delicious - will definitely make it again

I’ve used this recipe a lot and it’s always delicious. Family members have raved since the first time I had made it during a devastating hurricane. The smell that this gives off, feels like a holiday hug. This time around, I made them into little breakfast portions. Still came out at the recommended time. Makes enough to make like 13-14 cupcakes. I read a comment where they said it tasted like baking powder or something? No such thing! Maybe they used tablespoon instead of teaspoon? The only wonderful thing that lingers in your tastebuds is the cloves!
I have made this at least 6 times within the last 6 months. Everyone loves it. Family and friends favorite
Delicious!!!

I made this tonight and it went over huge with my family and I this came out AWESOME! ! 
P.S. if you put a little butter and sprinkle some brown sugar over it so delicious. ..
